source.title: LDH Laboratory Certification (chemistry + microbiology) + Louisiana Private Well Owner Network / private-well testing path
limitations: LDH Laboratory Certification chemistry and microbiology lists certify labs for Safe Drinking Water Act drinking-water analysis; private-well acceptance is not stated per commercial row unless the source marks it (Water Test, Inc. is marked PRIVATE WELLS ONLY on the microbiology list).

LDH Private Well Owner Network / Private Well Testing Information / egov Order Private Water Well Testing / Sample Drop-Off Locations PDF are the verified private-well sample paths (parish health units and five LDH OPH laboratory drop-off sites).

Municipal / public-water-system plant labs named on the microbiology and chemistry lists (city/parish utility labs, JRTC Fort Johnson, etc.) are omitted from the homeowner table unless an official source states they accept private-well samples.
Out-of-state certified chemistry labs omitted from the table — use the official Qualtrax chemistry list and the LDH homeowner analyte matrix PDF.
Shreveport Regional Laboratory phone appears as (318) 676-7809 on the microbiology certified list and (318) 676-7807 on the Sample Drop-Off Locations PDF — both printed forms noted; call to confirm.

Fees intentionally omitted from the table — LDH Private Well Testing Information page publishes sanitarian-collected and self-collect bacteriological fees; confirm current amounts on the official page.
Kansas KDHE AB Manager remains JS-only without a verified static export — skipped again.
Default box curl to ldh.la.gov returned 403; Safari UA curl and WebFetch succeeded.

verified_paths.name: LDH Private Well Owner Network — Order Private Water Well Testing + OPH / parish health unit sample path
verified_paths.notes: Official online order tool linked from LDH Private Well Owner Network and Private Well Testing Information. Sample drop-off / pick-up locations listed on LDH FINAL_Sample_Locations.pdf (five OPH laboratories Monday–Thursday by 2:00 pm excluding holidays, plus parish health units — call ahead). Contact PWI@LA.GOV or 1-888-293-7020. Fees: confirm on LDH Private Well Testing Information page (not republished here).

verified_paths.name: Water Test, Inc. — microbiology certified list marks PRIVATE WELLS ONLY
verified_paths.notes: Named on LDH List of Laboratories Certified by Louisiana for Drinking Water Analysis — Microbiology (March 2026) with annotation (PRIVATE WELLS ONLY). Address/phone as printed: 21220 Highway 36, Covington, LA 70433; (985) 892-8329; Contact Michael Metevier, President. Also appears on LDH chemistry homeowner matrix (as of 10/17/25) for total coliform. Call to confirm current packages and fees.
